svg.aria-label: A pull request on branch feat/export-cover-image titled feat: export the cover image. The PR rules check ticks the branch name, the title and each section, What, Why, How, Risk, Evidence and Checklist, against its limit, then shows passed, ready for review, and the Squash and merge button.
svg.text: Branch, title and every section, checked.
